title: Long-chat memory (compaction + saved-chat restore)
description: Multi-turn sessions driven through the real extension by run_session.py. Early turns agree on facts without editing; padding turns push the chat past its session budget so auto compaction folds those turns into the running summary; /compact folds the rest; the window is closed and the chat reopened from .blossom/chats; the last turn must act on the early facts. Passing means the facts survived compaction and restore.
